dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a nearly linear spline with minimal concave curvature, characteristic of a non-falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a minimal pixel radius, forming a sharp, pointed tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep incline of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height to base width ratio is approximately 1.4:1, indicating a tall, narrow silhouette.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius curve creating a broad, rounded convexity on the dorsal-anterior cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt projection with a pixel length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic false-coloration with high-intensity luminescent highlights across the dorsal ridge and melon.
